Enum Class BackboneTopology

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<BackboneTopology>
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.wizard.enums.BackboneTopology
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<BackboneTopology>, Constable
public enum BackboneTopology extends Enum<BackboneTopology>
Defines the inter-metro backbone link topology for connecting Cloud Routers across multiple Equinix metros. Selected via DeploymentWizard.Builder.backboneTopology(BackboneTopology); the wizard turns the chosen topology into concrete PlannedBackboneLinks between the recommended metros, in the order the optimizer ranked them.

  • Enum Constant Details

    • FULL_MESH

      public static final BackboneTopology FULL_MESH
      Every metro connects to every other metro: N*(N-1)/2 links. Maximum path diversity (any single link failure leaves all metros reachable) at the highest link count and cost. The default.

    • HUB_SPOKE

      public static final BackboneTopology HUB_SPOKE
      The hub metro connects to all others: N-1 links. The hub is the highest-ranked recommended metro (the optimizer's first recommendation); spoke-to-spoke traffic transits the hub, which is therefore a single point of failure. Cheapest topology for three or more metros.

    • RING

      public static final BackboneTopology RING
      Each metro connects to the next in rank order, and the last back to the first: N links for three or more metros. Survives any single link failure with one remaining path. With exactly two metros a ring degenerates to the single A–B link (the same one link FULL_MESH would produce) — never a doubly-billed duplicate pair.
